LanguageData.VBF_Intro: Every fix can be switched on and off on its own. Switching takes effect at once, no restart needed. A fix that cannot work in your game (another mod changes the same code) switches itself off and tells you why here.
LanguageData.VBF_StaggerStart: First stagger at the right speed
LanguageData.VBF_StaggerStartTip: The first time a pawn gets staggered, the base game slows it to almost nothing instead of 17 % speed. With this fix every stagger uses the speed it was meant to have. Modded races with their own stagger speed also get their value.
LanguageData.VBF_StaggerStartStats: Active. Corrected {0} staggers since the game was started.
LanguageData.VBF_PanicFlee: Badly hurt enemies can flee (changes gameplay)
LanguageData.VBF_PanicFleeTip: The base game is meant to let a badly hurt raider or visitor run away on their own. Each pawn has a personal limit somewhere between never and 39 % health. A math error puts that limit below zero for every pawn, so nobody ever flees from their wounds. With this fix about half of all human enemies will try to flee once they are hurt badly enough. Off by default because fights play out differently. Mods with their own flee rules, like RimPsyche Disposition, can replace this check. Then this fix has nothing to do.
LanguageData.VBF_PanicFleeStats: Active. Corrected {0} flee checks since the game was started.
LanguageData.VBF_ShieldDomeReach: Shields catch shots you're not looking at
LanguageData.VBF_ShieldDomeReachTip: Shots that are off screen move in bigger steps to save time. Shield domes only check where a step ends, so a shot can jump right over a small shield. Whether a mech shield, a Legionary or a low shield stops a bullet then depends on where your camera is. With this fix shields check the whole step.
LanguageData.VBF_MeleeDamageTotal: Melee hits count all their damage
LanguageData.VBF_MeleeDamageTotalTip: Some melee weapons deal extra damage on top of the main hit, like the EMP of a zeushammer or the flame of a plasma sword. The game then only looks at the last part of the hit. Hitting a slave with a zeushammer gives no suppression at all. Some hits also drop out of the combat log. With this fix the whole hit counts.
LanguageData.VBF_MeleeDamageTotalStats: Active. Counted {0} hits with extra damage since the game was started.
LanguageData.VBF_JobClearTip: The game reuses old job objects but forgets to reset four of their fields. A pawn can then carry over leftovers from an earlier job, for example a hauler whose "Carrying:" line is missing after someone read a book. This fix resets those fields.
LanguageData.VBF_PrioritySorterTip: When two needs have the same priority, the game is meant to pick one at random. An off-by-one error means the first entries of a list can never win such a tie. For example a hungry parent always eats before feeding their baby. This fix makes the pick random as intended.
LanguageData.VBF_TrainFoodOrder: Handlers wait for training cooldown before fetching food
LanguageData.VBF_TrainFoodOrderTip: Handlers fetch food for training before checking whether the animal can be trained again yet. Taming already checks in the right order. With this fix handlers only fetch food when the animal is ready.
LanguageData.VBF_TrainFoodOrderStats: Active. Stopped {0} early food trips since the game was started.
LanguageData.VBF_PlaceRadius: Map features spread out as planned
LanguageData.VBF_PlaceRadiusTip: When the game builds some map features, it means to scatter things over a small area. A setting gets lost on the way, so everything has to fit into a tiny spot. Insect caves (Odyssey) then never get more than 5 cocoons or egg sacs. The loot in the boss room is often missing too. Anomaly's undercave piles are capped too. With this fix new maps get the planned amounts. Insect caves get harder at high threat, as intended.
LanguageData.VBF_PlaceRadiusStats: Active. Widened the area for {0} placements since the game was started.
LanguageData.VBF_SettlementInhabitantsTip: The base game is meant to remember who lives in a faction base, so the people you meet there can show up again on your next visit. A reversed check means it never stores anyone. With this fix bases remember their residents. Who is still alive and free can come back, the rest is replaced as usual.
LanguageData.VBF_SettlementInhabitantsStats: Active. Corrected {0} resident checks since the game was started.
LanguageData.VBF_RoyalAscentRefire: Royal Ascent comes back after failing
LanguageData.VBF_RoyalAscentRefireTip: If the Royal Ascent quest fails, the game offers it again 22 days later. It is meant to look at the newest attempt, but it stops at the oldest one. So the quest comes back only once. Fail the second try and it never returns. With this fix the timer always follows the newest attempt.
LanguageData.VBF_RoyalAscentRefireStats: Active. Used the newest attempt {0} times since the game was started.
LanguageData.VBF_RefugeeFaction: Downed refugees can belong to a faction
LanguageData.VBF_RefugeeFactionTip: Refugees from the "rescue a downed refugee" quest are meant to come from one of the world's factions most of the time, like refugees from crashed pods. Two values are swapped, so they never belong to any faction. With this fix the quest uses the same 60 % chance as the rest of the game.
LanguageData.VBF_RefugeeFactionStats: Active. Corrected the faction chance for {0} refugees since the game was started.
LanguageData.VBF_PermitReadyMessage: Message when a royal permit is ready again
LanguageData.VBF_PermitReadyMessageTip: When a royal permit's cooldown ends, the game shows a message. It only checks one exact moment. Pawns are not updated every single moment, so the message is missing most of the time. The permit itself always becomes usable. With this fix the message shows up while the pawn is on a map. If the cooldown ends during a caravan trip, there is still no message.
LanguageData.VBF_PermitReadyMessageStats: Active. Showed {0} messages the base game would have missed.
